items.subject: R14 obligation ledger vs checkpoint narrative
items.conflict: The R15.2 command text quotes the R14 checkpoint as 21 DONE / 5 PARTIAL / 4 BLOCKED / 1 SOFT. The machine-readable OBLIGATIONS.json on the same branch reports 17 DONE / 9 PARTIAL / 1 BLOCKED_SOFT / 4 BLOCKED. Neither may be used as a verdict until the per-item candidate raw is recomputed.
items.next_legal_step: Recompute each of the 31 items against its own recorded candidate sha and raw log; publish the per-item table; do not overwrite either existing record.
items.far_recommendation: Treat OBLIGATIONS.json as the primary machine ledger and the checkpoint as narrative. Recompute affected items only (9 PARTIAL + 4 BLOCKED + 1 SOFT = 14), keep the 17 DONE as readback-only unless their candidate sha changed.
